_comment: Run with: pnpm mutate:run (uses Vitest as the test runner). Why inPlace: true — Stryker's default sandbox mode copies `mutate` targets + imports but NOT the test files. With `perTest` coverage analysis vitest must see test files at the package-root include paths. inPlace runs in the real directory with auto-backup/restore, so vitest's include patterns resolve correctly. See https://stryker-mutator.io/docs/stryker-js/configuration/#inplace-option
